q: Is the first session really free?
a: Yes. Your first session is free, so you can see if it helps before you pay anything. Message us on WhatsApp to book it.

q: How much does it cost after that?
a: The Student plan is ₹50 per month and the Teacher plan is ₹100 per month. See the Plans section for what each includes.

q: How do I ask a question?
a: Go to Ask your doubt, choose your level and subject, type your question and tap Send doubt on WhatsApp. WhatsApp opens with your question ready to send.
School and college students, teachers, and anyone learning on their own. If you are under 18, please ask a parent or guardian before you book a session.
We work hard to be accurate, but no one is right every time. For important exams, check key facts with your teacher or textbook. If you think an answer is wrong, tell us and we will fix it.

q: Can you help with exam stress?
a: We share simple routines and study plans that make exams feel more manageable. This is study support, not medical or counselling treatment. If you feel unsafe or hopeless, talk to a trusted adult now. In India, Tele-MANAS (14416) is free and open 24x7.
No. Nobody can promise marks. We help you understand the subject and study better, and your effort does the rest.

q: What happens to my question and details?
a: We use your question only to answer you. Please send only your question, and do not share your address, school name or other private details.

q: How can teachers or schools use StudyBridge?
a: Teachers can get lesson and practice-question help and see where students are stuck. Schools can message us on WhatsApp to talk about a programme for their students.
